note:
3295 -> 3270. The floor was wrong when it was committed, and its own note contains the mistake.

1fcc3d5f7d2 banked 3295 by arithmetic — old floor 3341 plus the change's -71, adjusted for 25 files it believed somebody else had landed unbanked. The note reasoned: 'a floor of 3341 + this change's -71 = 3270 would fail against the real 3295. Banking 3295 is the only value that is true of the tree.' The tree said 3270. The measurement it was reconciling against came from a detached worktree at 52a60efa3c0, and the branch was rebased before it landed, so the 25 were an artefact of comparing two different trees rather than 25 unformatted files anyone had added.

Verified by measuring /test_lint at the CI scope (--addons-path=odoo/addons,addons, -i test_lint alone) in a git-archive tree at each of 4f9e7bc4829, 1fcc3d5f7d2, 3e2cea4c580, d61d3cbf107, 5c4807329df, 2ae263169a4, f57cbefef48 and HEAD. All eight measure the same number, so nothing was repaid in between: the floor was never true of the tree it was committed to.

There is no separate 25-file debt to look for. Nobody should go looking for it again.
